transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (1284x1200 (window occupies the upper-left part; blank white below)) screenshot of a SnowPro-style Windows form; no app branding visible -> source_format 'other'. Companion record: nodate_takakkaw_falls_2012_11_27_en_b0b610 (English export of the same pit; chart offset by 1 px, same readings). Printed date 27/11/2012 (D/M/Y) agrees with the file name. Location field blank (site_name null; folder/file name say Takakkaw Falls). Height axis 2.7 px/cm with the same compressed 110-90 cm band as the other SnowPro screenshots of this batch, but HS 92 lies below it: all readings on the lower scale (90 cm gridline, 0 at the bottom). Boundaries 92/77/61/35/28/0 from bar edges (top border rows fall on integer cm) and H-column leader lines; table rows mapped one-to-one. Hardness axis non-linear (K, P, 1F, 4F, F at 216/108/54/27/~13 px from the bar origin). Bars: F, 4F, 1F+ (13 px past 1F), P+ (40 px past P), P+; R-column icons agree. Temperatures on 13.5 px/deg C (0 C at the 4F/0 gridline). No marker at the surface: the dashed air segment (from -7.5 at the plot top) runs down to the first circle at ~82 cm (HS-10), then a circle at 80 cm; printed surface temp -5.8 kept in header notes only. Markers 70/60 clear; 50-0 cm inside the hatched bars (visual, +-0.2 C).
